set_vacation.name: Set vacation
set_vacation.description: Sets the house-wide vacation switch of the heating control (optionally with start and end).

set_enabled.name: Enable or disable circuit
set_enabled.description: Enables or disables a heating or cooling circuit (ID: see attribute circuits of sensor.<room>_heat_control).

reset_manual.name: Clear manual setpoint
reset_manual.description: Ends a manually set setpoint; the circuit follows the schedule again.
